Toggle (pizzeria-toggle) and delete (pizzeria-del) both OK. (3) Hidden for panificio: after switching to 'panificio', panel-pizzeria count=0 while panel-piano-unico=1 (Piano Settimanale intact). No blocking console errors (only pre-gate 401s and harmless THREE/WebGPU warnings).

ui_bugs.issue: CRA webpack/eslint parser rejects inline optional-catch binding on the same-line arrow function 'const h = (e) => { try { ... } catch { setFloorRole(""); } };' with 'Parsing error: Unexpected token (266:29)'. Frontend fails to compile and blocks the entire UI. Standalone eslint passes but the CRA pipeline does not. Fixed by rewriting to multi-line try/catch(_err).

issues: Pizzeria panel is collapsed by default; user must click the header to reveal the CRUD. Consider defaultOpen when activity=='pizzeria' for parity with panel-piano-unico and panel-ordini (both defaultOpen).

When maturation > service_start (wraps to previous day), the label says '(day before)' but does not show the actual date; a small hint like the ISO date of the previous day would remove ambiguity for services near midnight.

action_items: Keep the App.js line-266 fix (multi-line try/catch). If reverted to the one-liner with `catch {` (no binding), CRA build breaks. Consider adopting the same style everywhere or upgrading the CRA babel preset if you want to keep terse one-liners.
Consider defaultOpen on panel-pizzeria (like panel-piano-unico) so it is immediately usable when activity=='pizzeria'.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js line 266 one-liner arrow function with optional catch binding is fragile under CRA's default parser — either standardize on `catch (_e)` or split multi-line to avoid the failure surface.

PizzeriaServizio.jsx uses `parseFloat(s.maturation_h)` inside doughStart but does not clamp negative or NaN values before Math.round; a bad string ('abc') will render nothing (falls into catch), but a legit '-5' would silently invert the calculation — consider validating maturation_h > 0.

In PianoUnico.jsx saveAll, `recipe_id` is still derived by slugifying the product name (line ~352) — assignee/team persistence is orthogonal but the same recipe_id-loss noted in iteration_239 still applies.
PianoUnico.jsx week normalization on load (useEffect) preserves batches but does NOT strip stale team entries; if the schema evolves the read path silently accepts any shape.

rca of the issue: Frontend was down at start with 'Failed to compile — Parsing error: Unexpected token (266:29)' in src/App.js. Column 29 of line 266 points to whitespace after `try {` in the one-liner `const h = (e) => { try { setFloorRole(...); } catch { setFloorRole(''); } };`. Root cause: CRA's built-in babel/eslint parser (via react-scripts) does not handle this specific combination (arrow function body containing try/optional-catch-binding on the same line) even though standalone ESLint accepts it and identical `catch { }` patterns work elsewhere in the codebase. Reproduction: revert to the one-liner and hot-reload; webpack reports 'Parsing error: Unexpected token (266:29)'. Mitigation applied: refactored to multi-line try { ... } catch (_err) { ... } — webpack now compiles with warnings only. Recommended long-term: standardize `catch (_e)` across the codebase and/or update react-scripts.
